description: Read one data module as structure, not XML: identification and status (DMC, issue, language, title, BREX ref, QA, DM-level applicability), the body as a tree of blocks (sections, paragraphs, lists, tables, figures with ICN, warnings/cautions/notes, numbered steps, requirements; processes and fault isolation too), the references it makes, ALWAYS a "verification" status (XSD by default) and ALWAYS "securityClassification" (the data module's value and the values carried by elements in the body, uninterpreted) at the top of the response. section "outline" returns a summary (headings, step numbers, first sentence, size of each subtree) for deciding what to read. Applicability of each block is evaluated for the given product (applicable / notApplicable / undetermined); without a product, only display texts are returned — assert expressions are never returned.

csdbDirs.description: CSDB folders to search for data modules by DMC, referenced objects, ACT/CCT/PCT and BREX (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes.

dmc.description: DMC of the data module to read from the CSDB (e.g. "S1000DBIKE-AAA-D00-00-00-00AA-041A-A"; "DMC-" prefix optional). Alternative to path/xml.

omitNotApplicable.description: Drop blocks that are notApplicable for the given product (default false: keep them, marked). The number dropped is reported.

outlineDepth.description: With section "outline": how many levels of headings / steps to return (default: all levels).

product.description: The product to evaluate applicability for. attributes: ACT productAttribute id → value (e.g. {"model": "Brook trekker", "version": "Mk9"}); conditions: CCT cond id → value. Omit to get "undetermined" with display texts only. Use describe_applicability to learn the available ids and values.

section.description: Which part to return (default all). "outline" returns only headings, step numbers, the first sentence and the size (nodes / chars / admonitions) of each subtree — call it first on a large data module to decide what to read.

verify.description: How much to verify before reading: "schema" (default) runs XSD validation only; "full" also checks BREX along the brexDmRef chain and resolves references; "none" skips verification (reported as not-run).

xml.description: The document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB).

name: read_data_module
